classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: The workflow will use broad GO terms for 'NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity' (GO:0004386) and 'NAD(P)H epimerase activity' (GO:0004387) as specific terms were not provided.
The workflow will retrieve sequences from all taxa unless specific organism constraints are provided.
The workflow will deduplicate sequences to ensure unique representatives.
The workflow will analyze sequences at pH 7.4 (physiological condition) unless specified otherwise.
The final ranking will be based on sequence quality metrics and biochemical annotations derived from the analysis step.
plan.goal: Retrieve representative protein sequences for NAD(P)HX repair enzymes using GO terms, perform sequence-level analysis to characterize them, and rank the candidates based on their biochemical properties and annotations.
missing_inputs: specific GO term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity
specific GO term for NADPHX epimerase activity
target protein family or organism constraints

success_criteria.goal: Produce a ranked list of representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with detailed biochemical annotations.
